item.text: {"search_note":"I found no direct evidence that Scholz personally censored satire, punished investigative journalists, banned opposition protest, or used civil-society monitoring as a tool of entrenchment in 2024. The negative evidence I found is mostly structural or indirect: the BND surveillance ruling and a separate criticism of pro-Palestinian speech restrictions. Netting that out, the record is still broadly permissive toward criticism, protest, and media scrutiny.","evidence":[{"title":"Rede von Bundeskanzler Olaf Scholz zum 75.
